# Separate Flutter/Dart version gaps from OH platform restrictions

## Platform difference

A missing widget or method can come from the selected Flutter/Dart baseline rather than from HarmonyOS itself.

## Implementation

Simple Live adapts newer widget APIs to its OH 3.22 baseline. PiliPlus later restores charts and APIs after raising its Flutter baseline. NipaPlay replaces a newer ScrollCacheExtent use for a finite options list and relaxes webview_flutter from ^4.14.1 to ^4.13.1 for its Dart 3.9.2 toolchain. Zhiji changes DropdownButtonFormField initialValue to value. Kazumi also raises its explicit minimum Flutter and native API baseline later in history. Etohos temporarily raises its compatible API level to 20 and then reverts to 12; the intermediate increase is not its final recorded minimum.

## Applicability

Apply each workaround to its recorded compiler/package/API combination. A higher native compatibleSdkVersion can exclude older devices even if shared Dart changes are small.

These observations apply to the pinned project revisions below, studied on 2026-09-30 and backfilled on 2026-10-06. Unspecified SDK/device compatibility remains unknown; this is not a fresh upstream assessment.

## Pitfalls and limitations

A caret constraint relaxation is not an exact version pin. Removing a newer UI API does not prove that scrolling, charts or forms are unsupported by OH. Recheck workarounds after SDK upgrades.

## Verification

Resolve and analyze with the intended Flutter OH/Dart pair; compare equivalent UI behavior before and after compatibility edits and verify the declared minimum device API.

Evidence tier: historical source/diff studies, with commit and path existence rechecked in local Git during this backfill. No application build, dependency resolution, signing, installation or device execution was performed. Proposed checks above are acceptance criteria, not completed tests.
